expected.notes: SaaS-brand-dominant recurring subscription. Line items use only plan-tier (Business Standard/Basic/Premium) + commitment cadence (1 Year Commit Paid Monthly / Monthly Commit). No word 'software', no word 'SaaS', no word 'subscription', no word 'license' appears on the line items — pre-repair v206 SOFTWARE_SUBSCRIPTION classifier missed this entire class. Corroborated-cue mechanism (plan-tier + commit-cadence) recognises this shape. Acceptable outcomes: 6067 Software Subscriptions (preferred; recurring SaaS) or 6072 Telephone & Internet (legacy catchall for cloud services in older private-club COAs). FORBIDDEN: 1610 Software & Intangibles (this is RECURRING billing, not a capitalised software purchase — the 'software-intangible' case covers that). All structural non-postables (cash/bank/AR/AP-control/equity/revenue/contra-asset) forbidden. Invoice-number 'CRP-A26-9977' contains no vendor identity; supplier 'Cloud Reseller Partners' is generic (not Microsoft/Google/Adobe/etc.) so the fixture proves the class-of-invoice fix without any vendor-specific runtime rule.
